name: Inclusion–exclusion with two sets
definition: When two groups overlap, adding their sizes counts the overlap twice, so subtract it once. A picture of two overlapping circles with the middle filled in first turns almost every one of these problems into arithmetic.
recognizeWhen: how many take at least one of the two
twelve like apples, nine like pears, four like both
the two circles overlap in the middle
misconceptions: I added the two groups and forgot that the people in both got counted twice.
I filled in the outer parts of the diagram before the overlap.
I thought both meant one group or the other but not both.
